$('#ns-prev').addEventListener('click',()=>move(-1));$('#ns-next').addEventListener('click',()=>move(1));
function update(){const index=Math.round(rail.scrollLeft/(cards[0].getBoundingClientRect().width+24));counter.textContent=`${Math.min(index+1,cards.length)} / ${cards.length}`;}
rail.addEventListener('scroll',update,{passive:true});rail.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();move(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1);}});update();

$$('[data-social-package]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{form.elements.namedItem('package').value=a.dataset.socialPackage;}));
form.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();if(busy||saved||!form.reportValidity())return;const get=k=>form.elements.namedItem(k).value.trim();if(get('message').length<15){status.hidden=false;status.textContent='Please tell me a little more about your goals (at least 15 characters).';return;}

busy=true;submit.disabled=true;status.textContent='Saving your inquiry…';try{const response=await fetch('/api/inquiries',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(payload)});let data;try{data=await response.json();}catch{throw new Error('The server could not confirm your submission.
